# COMcode block (C+) - v0.1.0
# BLOCK    0011AC00-0011ADFF
# ROLE     IPC events, bus orchestration, hardware handshakes, driver attachment, control plane signals; also success reports. May be printable; useful when showing the glyph of the error, not just its codename or codepoint.
#
# Subcategories:
#   0011AC00-0011AC1F  SUCS kernel & plugins (success reports)
#   0011AC20-0011AC5F  IPC events & control plane signals
#   0011AC60-0011AC9F  Bus orchestration & hardware handshakes
#   0011ACA0-0011ACDF  Driver attachment & power state
#   0011ACE0-0011ACFF  Stream & protocol handshakes
#   0011AD00-0011AD3F  Storage & boot (success reports)
#   0011AD40-0011AD7F  Storage IPC & device coordination
#   0011AD80-0011ADBF  Filesystem control plane
#   0011ADC0-0011ADFF  Reserved
#
